name: FUN_WF_TRANSACTION_ATTRS
description: This table contains the transaction attribute names required for each workflow to be shown as a summary in the report.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FAMILY_NAME
columns.description: Product family to which the workflow belongs to. Possible values are Financials, Procurement, Human Capital Management, and so on.

columns.name: PRODUCT_NAME
columns.description: Product to which the workflow belongs to. Possible values are Payables, General Ledger, and so on.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier for the workflow.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the workflow for which the transaction attributes are listed in the summary report.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE1_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute1.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE2_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute2.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE3_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute3.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE4_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute4.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE5_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute5.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE6_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute6.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE7_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute7.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE8_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute8.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE9_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute9.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE10_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The display name for the transaction attribute10.

columns.name: CONCATENATED_ATTRIBUTE_NAMES
columns.description: Concatenated display names for additional transaction attributes.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATA_SQL
columns.description: SQL query used to fetch the transaction data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
